decisions.original_claim: Observable multi-turn coding-agent failure modes can be categorized.
decisions.paper_framing: Use the six-label process taxonomy as a contribution.

decisions.evidence: controlled detector fixtures cover 6 labels with micro-F1=1.00; hard30 repetitive_exploration detector has TP=4, FP=0, FN=0; full30 sandbox_permission_deadlock has TP=1, FP=0, FN=0; full30 process-label repetitive_exploration has FP=2; hidden_semantic_edge_case recall=0.00.
decisions.original_claim: Trace rules detect most failure processes.
decisions.paper_framing: Claim trace-only rules detect observable process positives and expose hidden-semantic limits.

decisions.evidence: hard30 verification delta is +0.00 and exact success-check delta is +0.00; process-stress verification delta is +0.00 and exact success-check delta is +0.00; verification-lift verification delta is +0.00 and exact success-check delta is +0.00; verification-lift-v2 verification delta is +0.00 and exact success-check delta is +0.00; stored ordinary/weak-baseline pilots are saturated.
decisions.original_claim: Harness intervention increases ordinary-baseline verification rate.
decisions.paper_framing: Report saturated ordinary baselines as a negative result and limitation.

decisions.evidence: mechanism check only; not an ordinary baseline
decisions.original_claim: No-verify ablation shows harness control over verification behavior.
decisions.paper_framing: Use only as an auxiliary mechanism check, not as ordinary-baseline evidence.

decisions.evidence: hard30 repeated tool calls change -3.73, token usage -98656.8; process-stress repeated tool calls change -0.92, token usage -23868.4; verification-lift repeated tool calls change -0.75, token usage -4661.8; verification-lift-v2 repeated tool calls change -3.12, token usage -39165.2.
decisions.original_claim: Harness intervention reduces tool-call and token waste.
decisions.paper_framing: Lead RQ3 with paired hard30 waste reduction and supporting pilots.

decisions.evidence: hard10 success delta is +0.10; hard30 success delta is +0.00.
decisions.paper_framing: Report hard10 lift as pilot-qualified and hard30 as flat.

decisions.evidence: RQ4 signal audit ready=True; hard30 hidden failures have verification delta +0.00 and unresolved-error delta +0.00, while real process positives have large repeated-call, token, failure-score, command-failure, or recover-phase deltas.
decisions.original_claim: Trace signals explain whether an agent will fail.
decisions.paper_framing: Explain observable process failure signals and the hidden-semantic boundary, not all correctness failures.

summary.recommended_thesis: Coding-agent traces can diagnose observable multi-turn process failures and quantify harness-level waste reduction, but ordinary Codex baselines already verify on these small tasks, so verification-rate lift should be reported as a negative boundary result.
